title: Figure 28: Blood dialyzer illustration (labeled cutaway) and photograph
description: Composite figure captioned "Figure 28. Illustration (Left) and Photograph (Right) of a Blood Dialyzer as Used in Medicine." The left line drawing is a cutaway labeled "Blood inlet", "Header", "Tube sheet", "Solution outlet", "Fibers", "Jacket", "Solution inlet" and "Blood outlet"; the right photo shows a cylindrical hollow-fiber dialyzer with red and blue end caps. It appears in the 'Biomaterials in Dialysis' section.
